notes: Restraint only. 16 old species kinds merged into the four planned market-family kinds: cod+haddock; pollock/saithe+whiting+pouting; hake+phycid hake+hoki+ling+tusk; lingcod, NZ blue cod, flathead, King George whiting, wolffish and lionfish as types of Regional white fish. Regional names moved to aliases; fresh/frozen, fillet/loin and MSC as types. No old models existed; nothing dropped; no new kinds, no web research.
